record.question: Which statement is false regarding payment to contractors ?
options: Payment for all work other than daily labour shall be made on the basis of measurements recorded in measurement books
The claims for payments shall be prepared by the Drawing and Disbursing officers

No payment other than an advance payment may be authorised unless the correctness of the claim with respect to quantities, rates and qualities have been numerically checked carefully by a responsible officer
Advances paid to contractors must be recovered fully before final payment is made
